text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa...
This is the absolute best... I can do right now!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Even if I didn't have much of a winning weapon... I still pushed myself to the absolute limit!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Trainer.
Running in the Satsuki Sho was truly overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I was wondering what would happen before we ran...
Um, I'm truly sorry for causing you so much trouble~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, my blood ran cold before the race.
Because something unexpected happened.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaagh, Trainer, we have a huge problem!
I... I...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"The documents for the Satsuki Sho!
I forgot to submit the late entry form for myself~!
I hadn't planned on running at first, so it totally slipped my mind!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chowaa--?! What in the world?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Well, what does it matter?
It's just a document or two. Ha-ha-ha!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It is not okay~!
If you don't submit it, they won't let you race!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Because of my carelessness,
I ended up causing you extra trouble~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after the race. When I met up with Sakura Bakushin O
and we were about to head home—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oho? Please look over there.
That person surrounded up ahead is...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Brusqueman's Trainer!
Will her next race be straight to the Derby? Or will—

text_block_list.name: Talented Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Nothing is set in stone yet, but there's a strong
chance we'll go straight there. For now, at least.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Team Brusque Man was surrounded by press for an interview.
Though Kitasan Black had also put up a formidable run,
the spotlight remained entirely on the other side.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I'm still nowhere close in terms of popularity~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Not to worry! Don't let it get you down! The Classic Triple Crown has only just begun, hasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-san...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"There is no time to hang your head or look away!
Charge on toward tomorrow, heeeere we go!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees! Bakushin bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black is carried along by Sakura Bakushin O's boundless energy. Without stopping now, I just want her to dash right through this tunnel.
